channel.title: Mathematical Institute, University of Wrocław — news
channel.description: Announcements, events and achievements of the Mathematical Institute, University of Wrocław.

item.title: TEST: Open Institute meeting - events preview
item.description: TEST - sample event on 17 November, 16:00-17:30. This entry tests the calendar and event lists; it does not announce a real event.

item.title: TEST: Mathematics open day for prospective students
item.description: TEST - sample event, not a real announcement. Short lectures, meetings with students and science clubs, and everything about admission to mathematics. Saturday 14 November, 10:00–14:00.

item.title: TEST: Open lecture: What do random matrices know about prime numbers?
item.description: TEST - sample event, not a real announcement. Prof. Mister Test (Test University) on the surprising link between the zeros of the Riemann zeta function and eigenvalues of random matrices.

item.title: TEST: Workshop for secondary school students: from the Ulam spiral to RSA
item.description: TEST - sample event, not a real announcement. Four hours of activities on prime numbers and cryptography for secondary school students. Schools can register groups of up to 30.

item.title: TEST: Student club meeting: combinatorial games, or why everything is Nim
item.description: TEST - sample event, not a real announcement. A popular talk on combinatorial games and the Sprague–Grundy theorem. Free entry, no registration needed.

item.title: Maciej Tadej
item.description: Analysis and simulations of the non-linear models with non-local dispersal of species considered in finite, flat habitats

item.title: The tutoring room opens
item.description: From 19 October, senior students help with maths problems in room 202 — especially first-year students.

item.title: Job as a mathematics tutor
item.description: JUBSOFT Piotr Zięba (the Korepetycje Matematyki brand) will hire mathematics students as mathematics tutors.

item.title: Welcome, first-year students
item.description: The matriculation ceremony of the Faculty of Mathematics and Computer Science took place on 29 September in the Leopoldina Hall.

item.description: A preparatory course for students admitted to the first year at the Faculty — from 25 September.

item.description: Open lecture “Who was Seki Takakazu?” as part of the IDUB programme.

item.title: We have been awarded the A+ research category
item.description: Mathematics at the University of Wrocław received the highest research rating, A+.

item.title: Job for a mathematics teacher at TEB Edukacja Technical and General Secondary School in Wrocław
item.description: TEB Edukacja Technical and General Secondary School in Wrocław will hire a mathematics teacher. Second-cycle (master’s) students are also welcome.

item.title: Baby Steps Beyond the Horizon — a school for students
item.description: A school in Będlewo (30 August – 5 September 2026) showing students the breadth of current mathematics. On-site registration until 31 July.

item.title: Job for a mathematics teacher at Primary School No. 107 in Wrocław
item.description: Piotr Włostowic Primary School No. 107 in Wrocław will hire a mathematics teacher. Applications from final-year students will be considered.

item.title: Job at the Poznań University of Life Sciences
item.description: Competition for an assistant position in the Department of Mathematical and Statistical Methods at the Poznań University of Life Sciences.

item.title: Statistics seminar
item.description: Two meetings on statistical methods for high-dimensional data and modelling in molecular biology — 22 and 24 June.

item.description: Dr Piotr Dyszewski and Dr hab. Michał Marcinkowski are the winners of the first edition of the award.

item.title: Faculty seminar: Prof. Olga Vitek
item.description: “Statistical methods increase the accuracy and the interpretability of quantitative proteomic investigations” — 23 June, room 119, Institute of Computer Science.

item.title: Job for a mathematics teacher at the “Jaskółka” Primary School in Wrocław
item.description: The “Jaskółka” independent primary school in Wrocław is looking for a mathematics teacher from the new school year.

item.description: Surveys evaluating summer-semester classes can be completed in USOSweb until 30 June.

item.description: One of the most important and prestigious mathematical distinctions in Poland.

item.description: The award recognises a paper co-authored with Jean Bourgain and Elias M. Stein.
